name: 蕭俊祥
objective:
先修課程: 負責教授同意。1. 數位影像基礎，2. 空間域影像強化，3. 頻域影像強化，4. 影像還原，5 彩色影像處理，6 形態學影像處理，7. 影像分割，8. 影像幾何轉換，9. 機器視覺系統。
1. Fundamental digital image, 2. Image enhancement in the spatial domain, 3. Image enhancement in the frequency domain, 4. Image restoration, 5. Color image processing, 6. Morphological image processing, 7. Image segmentation, 8. Geometric transform of image, 9. Machine vision system.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1:  Introduction to Python
Week 2:  Introduction to OpenCV
Week 3-4:  Image enhancement in the spatial domain, 
Week 5-6: Image restoration,
Week 7: Color image processing
Week 8: Midterm Exam 
Week9-11: Color image processing 
Week12: Morphological image processing 
Week13: Image segmentation
Week14: Geometric transform 
Week15: Machine vision system.
Week16: Final Exam
